components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      properties:

          description: The ID of the specialty.

          minimum: 0

        name:

          description: The name of the specialty.

          example: radiology

        - id

## Summary

I implemented telephone normalization on owner creation. Two changes were needed because the DTO is bean-validated *before* the controller runs:

**1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — The generated `OwnerFieldsDto` had `pattern: '^[0-9]*$'` on `telephone`, which would reject input like `"(04) 1234-5678"` with a 400 before any normalization could occur. I relaxed it to `'.*\S.*'` (non-blank) so raw, unnormalized numbers reach the controller.

**2. `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — On create, the telephone is now normalized by stripping every non-digit character (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), then required to be exactly 10 digits:
- If it's not exactly 10 digits after stripping → `400 Bad Request`.
- Otherwise the 10-digit value is stored and returned as `telephone`.

The existing `Owner` entity constraint `@Pattern(regexp = "^[0-9]{10}$")` still holds, since the value persisted is already the normalized 10 digits.

Verification of the two acceptance tests:
- `coreStripsToTenDigits`: `"(04) 1234-5678"` → stored/returned as `"0412345678"`. ✅
- `errorRejectsTooFewDigits`: `"12345"` → 400. ✅
